game_concept: A strategy race set in Sand Dunes – Sundial Plaza, a giant sundial plaza: the desert nomad must handle sandstorms while practicing debugging & combined skills. Core idea – Algorithm Race: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process.
theme: Sand Dunes – Sundial Plaza: a giant sundial plaza
core_gameplay_loop: In Sundial Plaza, repeat each round: Choose the faster of two approaches (loop vs formula) to out-pace a rival process. Each round the rival advances, and solving the step moves the desert nomad ahead. Then check the speed value and advance.
player_objective: Beat a rival AI to the bazaar gate by solving code steps involving speed that move the desert nomad forward.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
win_condition: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.05).
lose_condition: The rival reaches the bazaar gate first, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 9 – Debugging & Combined Skills | Level 9 (extended tier): Algorithm Race
assets_style: sun-baked pixel-art desert: golden dunes, tall cacti, a bright blue oasis, warm orange shadows; flat Kenney-style sprites; desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Algorithm Race' (Week 9 slot 12), mission type 'Rival Race', and setting 'Sundial Plaza'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Sand Dunes
region.mood: desert oud, hand drums and sandy wind

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how speed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against sandstorms in Sundial Plaza.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Player progress reaches 100% before the rival does (rival speed 1.05).
